messages:
marco_csm: Heads-up: GreenRoot has a press demo Friday and theyre asking for short-lived uplift in ap-southeast-1. Request: 2x QPS on /v1/chat and /v1/embeddings, add allowlist 203.119.0.45/32, pin routing to ap-southeast-1 for the org during the window. Window: 2025-05-02 09:00-11:00 UTC. This demo ties into their renewal conversations  potentially moving to Dedicated if its smooth. Can we prioritize?

sara_support: Ack. Need org id, exact model route(s) (model name or tag), and whether they want auto-revoke. Also flagging security review.

GreenRoot_OPS: Org id: org_greenroot_11. Models: chat uses redwood-chat-1 (route /v1/chat), embeddings route /v1/embeddings uses embed-small-v2. Auto-revoke yes. Contact: press@greenroot.ai.

oncall_josh: Plan: 1) create region pin policy for org_greenroot_11 -> ap-southeast-1 (fallback allowed), 2) apply per-route qps_override=2.0 for the two routes, 3) add ACL 203.119.0.45/32, 4) schedule expiry 2025-05-02T11:00:00Z. Tagging @nina_eng for quick security sign-off.

nina_eng: Reviewing IP + org. IP looks fine. Approve ACL + region pin. Quick suggestion: for embeddings route cap concurrent requests to 1200 to avoid OOM on older workers. Approve overall.

sara_support: I'll stage the patch and run a smoke. Command to run (staging):

```bash
redwoodctl orgs patch-policy --org org_greenroot_11 \
  --patch '{"region_pin":"ap-southeast-1","routes":{"/v1/chat":{"qps_override":2.0},"/v1/embeddings":{"qps_override":2.0,"concurrency_cap":1200}},"acls":["203.119.0.45/32"]}' \
  --region ap-southeast-1 --expires 2025-05-02T11:00:00Z
```

sara_support: staging smoke OK, pushing to prod in ~1m. console: https://console.redwood.example/orgs/org_greenroot_11/policies

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch start_time=2025-05-01T16:42:23Z actor=sara_support status=queued

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch actor=sara_support status=success time=2025-05-01T16:44:10Z ref=patch-91244

oncall_josh: Verified region pin + ACL + qps overrides live in ap-southeast-1. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2025-05-02T11:00:00Z. Will monitor metrics during window and post any spikes/errors.

GreenRoot_OPS: Thanks all  doing a quick warmup now. If demo performance looks good, wed like a follow-up on Dedicated pricing and SLA options.

marco_csm: Noted  I'll add to renewal tracker and schedule a technical deep-dive next week if demo goes well. Adding feedback request: lower long-term token cost and pre-warming guidance. :rocket:
